display.purpose: Landing headline only, inside the framed empty sheet; condensed uppercase, balanced wrap, second clause in the rubric; 28px under 720px.

wordmark.purpose: evmdec, lowercase, one word, first band cell; no logo exists.

risk.purpose: The title-block risk value in band amber when the score is 8 or above; otherwise Barlow 500 14px in band pale.

action.purpose: The Decompile button; the chain select (500 14px .04em) and theme toggle (500 13px .06em) are its quieter siblings.

body.purpose: UI text, finding titles (500) and bodies (70ch), landing paragraph (62ch), report prose (90ch), scale line (13px), title-block values (500, tabular).

heading.purpose: Tabs (.1em), Download .sol (rubric), report section headings (.12em), outline example buttons (.08em); condensed tracked uppercase.

label.purpose: Title-block labels (500, band muted), column and group headings (600, muted), Try label and landing footer, report table headers (600, .08em).

severity.purpose: CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / INFO in a finding row and the callout number; colour only tints the word.

code.purpose: The drawing and pre blocks (13px); the band query field (14px); tab-size 4; function names at 600.

code-small.purpose: Function index rows (12.5px), evidence wells and finding meta code (12px), report code (12.5px).

fonts.fallback: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

fonts.role: labels, headings, tabs, actions, wordmark, headline

fonts.fallback: ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

shadows.name: tab-underline
shadows.purpose: The selected tab's 2px rubric rule, drawn inset; the only box-shadow in the system and not an elevation.

borders.name: band-line
borders.purpose: Rules between band cells (header strip, title block); the title block closes with a 2px band rule.

borders.name: line
borders.purpose: Heavy rule between sheet regions: the three columns, column headings, tab strip, the empty-sheet frame, outline buttons; error notices use the rubric.

borders.name: hair
borders.purpose: Light rule inside a region: index rows, tab dividers, scale line, findings, evidence wells, report tables, the frame inset (6px) and landing footer.

borders.name: revision-cloud
borders.value: border: 6px solid transparent; border-image: var(--cloud) 6 round
borders.purpose: Scalloped outline on a flagged code line; --cloud is an inline 18x18 SVG of eight 3px arcs stroked in the sheet rubric (vermilion in light, amber in dark). Positioned absolutely from calc(12em - 7px) to 4px from the right edge.

focus.name: focus-visible
focus.purpose: Sheet controls; blue in light, amber in dark; no border change or glow.

focus.name: focus-visible-band
focus.purpose: Controls inside the header strip and title block: amber, inset so it stays within the 44px cell.

motion.name: lit-settle
motion.purpose: The only transition: the lit background on code lines and findings, declared under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference only.

motion.name: primary-hover
motion.purpose: Instant hover step on the Decompile button; not a transition.

breakpoints.name: two-column
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: index 240px, details drop below full width with a top rule, title block 4 per row.

breakpoints.name: stacked
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: frame unfixes, band wraps (wordmark, field, select+Decompile, toggle), title block 2 per row, columns stack (index list 40vh, drawing panel 70vh), empty sheet 24px 20px with a 28px headline.

layout.frame: body grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0,1fr); 100% height; columns scroll independently; body[data-state=empty] collapses to auto minmax(0,1fr) and shows only the band and #landing
layout.band: header cells 44px tall; brand 0 18px; field 0 14px; select 0 32px 0 14px with 12x8 chevron at right 12px; primary 0 22px; toggle 0 16px
layout.emptySheet: .sheet width min(100%,760px), padding 36px 40px 32px, inset hairline at 6px; #landing padding 48px 24px 64px
layout.titleBlock: repeat(8, minmax(0,1fr)); cells 7px 14px 9px on the band; 2px band rule below
layout.targets: button min-height/min-width 24px; band controls 44px; line links 24px

accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on both themes including code highlighting and severity colours
Severity and confidence printed as words; colour never carries severity alone
Minimum 24x24 targets on every button and line link

ARIA tablist with roving tabindex, aria-selected, aria-controls; aria-expanded findings; aria-current index rows; aria-pressed theme toggle; aria-busy on body while decompiling; error notices use role=alert
Polite role=status live region announces theme changes, decompile start and result, chosen findings and lines
Theme follows prefers-color-scheme with data-theme override persisted to localStorage

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Drawing Set"**

The contract is a built structure and the page is its drawing set. A dark ink band across the top carries the header strip and the title block, the way a drawing's title block sits in its own ruled strip; below it the sheet is the drawing. Functions are an indexed sheet list (F-01, F-02, ...) down the left on a recessed well; the decompiled code is the drawing in the middle; every finding is a numbered callout in the code gutter keyed to a detail at the right. The world refuses the category's console (side nav, dark slate, badges) and the report-PDF arrangement. Everything is drawn in line: one-pixel rules divide every region, nothing has a shadow, nothing has a radius except the callout circles, and nothing is labelled twice.

Two sheets exist under one band. In light the sheet is a whiteprint: white ground, iron-black line and type, one vermilion rubric reserved for callouts, the revision cloud, the selected-tab rule, Download and the Decompile action. In dark the sheet is a blueprint: Prussian-blue ground, pale line and type, an amber rubric in the same roles. The band is ink in both themes (deeper in dark), with pale type, tracked condensed labels and an amber band-rubric that carries the risk figure and the band's focus ring. The theme follows the system and can be overridden by the header toggle; both sheets meet WCAG 2.2 AA including the code highlighting and the severity colours.

Lettering is draughting-room: Barlow for reading text, Barlow Condensed in tracked capitals for every label, heading, tab, action and the wordmark, Source Code Pro for code, selectors and evidence. The faces load from Google Fonts with the system stacks as fallbacks. Density is that of a drawing, not a dashboard: 14px body on a 1.45 line, 13px code on a 1.5 line, 12px tracked labels over tabular values. The only motion is the lit background settling in over 200ms; nothing else moves, and reduced motion removes even that.
keyCharacteristics: An ink band (header strip and title block) over a light or Prussian sheet; 44px header cells divided by band rules.
Hairline rules at 1px divide every region; no shadows, no fills for structure; the sheet frame on the empty state is a 1px line with an inset hairline.
One rubric per sheet (vermilion / amber) for callouts, the cloud, the selected tab, Download and Decompile; one band-rubric (amber) for the risk figure.
Zero radius everywhere except the 24px circular callout.
Barlow Condensed tracked uppercase for every label, heading, tab and action; Barlow for prose; Source Code Pro for code.
Fixed-cell lists whose columns never move; the chosen line or finding stays lit until another is chosen.
A scalloped revision cloud outlines every flagged line of the drawing.

rules.name: The One Rubric Rule
rules.body: Each sheet has exactly one accent and it marks only what a reviewer would mark in red: the callout, the cloud, the selected tab's rule, the download and decompile actions, an error. The band has its own single accent, amber, for the risk figure and band focus. Nothing decorative wears either.

rules.name: The Words First Rule
rules.body: Severity and risk are read from the printed word (HIGH, 76/100 · High); the colour tints the word and never stands alone. A risk score under 8 drops the band rubric and prints in band pale at Barlow 500 14px.

rules.name: The Two Sheets Rule
rules.body: Every sheet token has a whiteprint and a blueprint value, and every pair meets AA contrast on its ground; the band keeps the same pale type on both of its inks. Add a colour to both sheets or to neither.

rules.name: The Tracked Label Rule
rules.body: Anything that names a cell, a column, a group, a view or an action is Barlow Condensed in uppercase, tracked 0.08-0.14em, set above or beside its value, and never repeated as a heading elsewhere. Prose is never condensed.

rules.name: The Ink Code Rule
rules.body: Code is set in ink: keywords, types, numbers and function names share the text colour; only comments drop to muted and strings take green. Emphasis in code is weight (600 function names), not colour.

rules.name: The Fixed Cell Rule
rules.body: Index rows, title-block cells, code lines and finding rows are grids with fixed first columns; content never shifts a column. Long names break at `(` and `,` via soft wraps, long addresses break anywhere, but the grid does not move.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts off the sheet. Hierarchy is drawn with planes, rules, fills and weight; a shadow, a glow or a blur is a foreign material.

dos: Do keep the header strip and title block on the band ink with pale type and band rules; the sheet below is the only place the theme ground changes.
Do divide regions with 1px rules: `line` between regions, `hair` within them, `band-rule` inside the band; a region's boundary is a rule, never a fill or a shadow.
Do set every label, heading, tab and action in Barlow Condensed uppercase tracked 0.08-0.14em, and label each thing once; set prose and values in Barlow, code in Source Code Pro.

Do keep the sheet rubric for callouts, the revision cloud, the selected-tab rule, Download, Decompile and error borders (vermilion on the light sheet, amber on the dark), and band amber for the risk figure and band focus.
Do print severity and confidence as words beside each other; colour only tints the severity word.

Do give every control at least a 24x24 target (44px in the band) and a visible 2px focus outline; use `aria-current`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-selected`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-busy` and the polite `role=status` region for every state change.
Do define any new sheet colour on both sheets and verify AA contrast on each ground, and on the band ink for band colours.
Do use the lit fill (straw / umber) for exactly the chosen item: one index row, one code line, one finding.
donts: Don't add border-radius to anything but the 24px callout circle; buttons, fields, the select, tabs, wells, frames and notices stay square.
Don't add box-shadows, glows, blurs or gradients; the only inset shadow is the 2px selected-tab underline used as a rule, and the only hover filter is the primary's 8% brightness step.
Don't set prose, finding bodies or values in the condensed face, and don't set labels in Barlow regular; width and case carry the hierarchy.
Don't colour code tokens beyond ink, muted comments and green strings, or convey emphasis in code with colour instead of weight.
Don't let a column move: fixed first cells (3.4em line numbers, 8.6em callout cell, 3.2em sheet number, 30px finding number) hold their width regardless of content.
Don't animate anything but the lit background (200ms ease-out), and never under reduced motion.
Don't introduce badges, pills, side navigation or a grey-slate console; the band is navy ink and the dark sheet is Prussian blue, not grey.
